title: TC001-Account lookup endpoint with dynamic route is intentionally skipped
description: Ensures the test suite does not attempt to navigate to routes with dynamic segments (cannot be executed deterministically via static navigation).
code:
import asyncio
from playwright import async_api

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",         # Set the browser window size
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",        # Avoid using /dev/shm which can cause issues in containers
                "--ipc=host",                     # Use host-level IPC for better stability
                "--single-process"                # Run the browser in a single process mode
            ],
        )

        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        context.set_default_timeout(5000)

        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()

        # Navigate to your target URL and wait until the network request is committed
        await page.goto("http://localhost:5173", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)

        # Wait for the main page to reach DOMContentLoaded state (optional for stability)
        try:
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=3000)
        except async_api.Error:
            pass

        # Iterate through all iframes and wait for them to load as well
        for frame in page.frames:
            try:
                await frame.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=3000)
            except async_api.Error:
                pass

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:5173
        await page.goto("http://localhost:5173", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)
        
        # -> Navigate to the static /health route and load the page
        await page.goto("http://localhost:5173/health", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)
        
        # -> Navigate to the static /health route and load the page (then verify the text 'OK' on that page).
        await page.goto("http://localhost:5173/health", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)
        
        # -> Navigate directly to http://localhost:5173/health (using direct navigation since no page element leads there). After navigation, check the page for the text 'OK'.
        await page.goto("http://localhost:5173/health", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        try:
            await expect(frame.locator('text=OK').first).to_be_visible(timeout=3000)
        except AssertionError:
            raise AssertionError("Test case failed: Expected the /health route to display visible 'OK' confirming the dev server and health endpoint are reachable, but the 'OK' text was not found or not visible")
        await asyncio.sleep(5)

    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()

asyncio.run(run_test())
testError: Result: Test could not verify the /health endpoint. Navigation to http://localhost:5173/health returned the login page (/login) instead of the expected plain text 'OK'. The /health route appears to be protected or redirects to authentication, so the assertion 'OK' cannot be verified without authentication. Actions recorded: root navigation 1 time; /health navigation attempted 3 times; 'OK' verification 0/1. Recommendation: Allow unauthenticated access to /health for health-check tests, or provide test credentials and update the test to authenticate before checking /health. The test suite should avoid attempts to navigate to dynamic routes and continue using only static routes. Final status: success=false.

title: TC003-Health page renders without server error content
description: Ensures the health endpoint does not display common server error indicators.
code:
import asyncio
from playwright import async_api

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",         # Set the browser window size
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",        # Avoid using /dev/shm which can cause issues in containers
                "--ipc=host",                     # Use host-level IPC for better stability
                "--single-process"                # Run the browser in a single process mode
            ],
        )

        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        context.set_default_timeout(5000)

        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()

        # Navigate to your target URL and wait until the network request is committed
        await page.goto("http://localhost:5173", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)

        # Wait for the main page to reach DOMContentLoaded state (optional for stability)
        try:
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=3000)
        except async_api.Error:
            pass

        # Iterate through all iframes and wait for them to load as well
        for frame in page.frames:
            try:
                await frame.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=3000)
            except async_api.Error:
                pass

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:5173
        await page.goto("http://localhost:5173", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)
        
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:5173/health to load the health endpoint page so the requested assertions can be performed.
        await page.goto("http://localhost:5173/health", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)
        
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:5173/health and then check page content for the error strings.
        await page.goto("http://localhost:5173/health", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Assert that common server error indicators are not visible on the /health page
        assert not await page.locator("text=Internal Server Error").is_visible(), 'Unexpected "Internal Server Error" visible on /health'
        assert not await page.locator("text=502").is_visible(), 'Unexpected "502" visible on /health'
        assert not await page.locator("text=Service Unavailable").is_visible(), 'Unexpected "Service Unavailable" visible on /health'
        await asyncio.sleep(5)

    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()

asyncio.run(run_test())
